mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates the Federal Reserve is easing monetary policy, which lowers discount rates and increases the present value of expected equity cash flows, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances despite a sustained FEDFUNDS decline, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 12-month window.
